meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上该技能并完成设置后，Claude 可以接收微信个人账号的消息并自动回复。设置过程包括扫码登录和绑定消息组。
howto.when: 当微信用户向机器人账号发送消息时，且频道已启用、扫码登录完成、消息组已绑定 agent 组，Claude 会收到消息并处理。

say.text: 如果我在微信上发消息，你会回复吗？
say.note: Claude会回复收到的微信消息

say.text: 请把微信上陌生人发来的消息先给我审批

howto.what_en: After installation and configuration, Claude can receive messages from personal WeChat accounts and reply automatically. Setup includes QR code login and wiring the messaging group to an agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a WeChat user sends a message to the bot account, provided the channel is enabled, QR login completed, and the messaging group is wired to an agent group.

say_en.text: Will you reply if I send you a message on WeChat?
say_en.note: Claude will reply to incoming WeChat messages.

say_en.text: Please require my approval for messages from unknown WeChat users.
